features.title: Chakra Core Integration for Financial Applications

openQuestions.text: US 48958, US 48967, and US 48976 describe cosmetic product regulatory classification, compositional data upload, and IFRA compliance assessment — these appear unrelated to Chakra Core engine integration. Confirm whether these stories belong to Feature 48842 or were misattributed; they are excluded from this spec's functional scope pending clarification.
What is the specific time limit (SLA) for engine initialization referenced in US 48850, Criteria 2?
What are the specific performance benchmarks and resource utilization thresholds referenced in US 48877?
What UI screens, layouts, or interaction designs (if any) are required for developers/security officers/compliance managers to configure, debug, or review script-related functionality?
What are the exact API endpoint definitions, request/response schemas, authentication mechanism, and error code taxonomy for the exposed financial APIs referenced in US 48868 and US 48859?
What is the data retention period for audit logs and anomaly monitoring data?
What specific fields comprise script execution log records, API usage log records, and permission set records?
What is the granular permission model distinguishing access rights among Developer, Security Officer, Compliance Manager, and QA Engineer roles?
What rules define "anomalous behavior" for script execution monitoring (US 48949)?
What sandbox policy configuration options and default restrictions are required beyond "restricted files or network resources" (US 48922)?

userStories.title: As Developer, I want to embed Chakra Core engine into the financial application to achieve enhanced scripting capabilities
As Developer, I want to initialize Chakra Core engine with financial context to achieve correct environment setup
As Developer, I want to expose custom financial APIs to scripts to achieve extensible scripting capabilities
As Developer, I want to optimize Chakra Core engine performance to achieve efficient financial computation
As a Regulatory Specialist, I want to classify ABCD Shampoo as a rinse-off product so that it is correctly categorized for compliance
As a Regulatory Analyst, I want to upload detailed compositional data of all substances in the product so that regulatory assessments can be performed accurately
As a Compliance Officer, I want the system to assess product compliance with IFRA standards so that we ensure ingredient safety
As QA Engineer, I want to verify script execution correctness to achieve reliable financial calculations
As Developer, I want to implement debugging tools for scripts to achieve faster issue resolution
As Developer, I want to handle script exceptions gracefully to achieve robust financial application behavior
As Developer, I want to support asynchronous script execution to achieve non-blocking financial workflows
As Security Officer, I want scripts sandboxed to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive financial data
As Compliance Manager, I want audit logging of script executions to achieve traceability for financial regulations
As Security Officer, I want to configure script execution permissions to achieve controlled and safe script operations
As Security Officer, I want to monitor script execution for anomalous behavior to achieve proactive risk mitigation
